bullish: Pivot Supertrend in Up Trend mode AND price > trail level
Laguerre RSI < 0.15 (oversold) OR fresh cross-up from below 0.15 OR Long Entry flag = 1.0
STRONG BUY = all 5 conditions met. NORMAL BUY = 4/5 with Conf ≥ 6 mandatory.
bearish: Pivot Supertrend in Down Trend mode AND price < trail level
Laguerre RSI > 0.85 (overbought) OR fresh cross-down from above 0.85 OR Short Entry flag = 1.0
STRONG SELL/SHORT = all 5 conditions met. NORMAL SELL = 4/5 with Conf ≥ 6 mandatory.
neutral: OR Choppiness > 0.5 (sideways market — trend signals untrustworthy)
OR Laguerre RSI in mid-zone 0.15-0.85 with no fresh cross
OR Pivot Supertrend just flipped within last 1-2 bars (wait for confirmation)
Action: stand aside, no new positions
avoid_chasing: Long: do NOT enter if Laguerre RSI > 0.80 even with strong trend — wait for pullback to <0.15
Short: do NOT enter if Laguerre RSI < 0.20 even with strong downtrend — wait for bounce to >0.85
Reason: entering at extreme RSI = buying tops / selling bottoms

risk_rules: Risk per trade: max 1% of account equity
Sector cap: max 2 positions in same SET sector (BANK, ENERGY, RETAIL, etc.)
Daily loss limit: -2% of account → stop trading rest of day
Weekly loss limit: -5% → reduce size by half next week
After 3 consecutive losses: skip next signal regardless of setup quality
Position sizing: size = (account × 1%) / (entry - stop), round down to lot
rules.notes: Universe = SET100 + my core watchlist. Default TF = Daily (swing). Indicators are the SET-tuned set: Pivot Point Supertrend [SET], 7-Star Confluence Dashboard, Laguerre RSI Ehlers [SET], Hurst Choppiness [SET] Regime. CPR Camarilla used as discretionary support/resistance overlay on focus names. Brief output format: per symbol → BIAS | SETUP STAGE (waiting/triggered/in-trade/exit) | KEY LEVEL | TRIGGER | INVALIDATION. End with SET regime read + top 3 actionable setups.
